$Comment: The Fire Resistance Potion (Item/Items/Hallows_Eve/Hallows_Eve_Fire_Resistance_Potion.json): drunk, it halves Fire damage for three minutes, for a player heading into the Headless Horseman's graveyard. Open to everyone: no Requires, no purchase limit and no rotation. SortOrder 5 puts it first on the gear shelf, ahead of the Jack Helm (10). Cost is the price in Hallow Sweets; the reward's Count is how many potions each purchase hands over. Named by the item's own keys.
